department: Department of Molecular Biology and Biochemistry

deadline.value: Complete applications for Fall 2027 are due June 1, 2027 (window opens October 15, 2026); the department admits year-round.
deadline.quote: Accepting applications for Fall 2027 start: October 15, 2026 - June 1, 2027

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 5.0 or higher on the new scale (100 for tests before January 21, 2026), above the SFU minimum.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score 5.0 or higher (for test results prior to January 2026, minimum of 100) OR IELTS score of 7.0 or higher

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each section.
ielts_min.quote: TOEFL score 5.0 or higher (for test results prior to January 2026, minimum of 100) OR IELTS score of 7.0 or higher | 7.0 (min. 6.5 in each section)

english_waiver.value: An English-medium degree from India does not waive the test, because India's primary language is not English.
english_waiver.quote: If English is not the primary language in your home country, then yes. You will still be required to submit an English-language test score, even if your previous degree program was taught in English.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must have a supervisor who has agreed to take you into their lab before you apply; do not pay the fee until then.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must have found a Supervisor who has agreed to take you into their lab to be considered for admission to the program.

funding.value: PhD students get a guaranteed minimum stipend of CAD 30,500 plus a CAD 5,508 PhD Research Scholarship in years 1-4, for five years; tuition is not included.
funding.quote: Effective Fall 2026 the minimum stipend is $28,500 for MSc students and $30,500 *(+ $5,508 PhD Research Scholarship in years 1-4) for PhD students. | The guaranteed financial support lasts three years for MSc students and five years for PhD students.

entry_route.value: You can enter the PhD with a BSc (more coursework) or an MSc.
entry_route.quote: Students who enter the PhD program with a Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree, or equivalent, will achieve a minimum total of 15 units of course work. | Students who enter the program with a Master of Science (MSc) degree will complete a minimum total of eight units

notes: Specializations include bioinformatics, oncology (IOGS) and translational neuroscience (TRAIN). SFU also has a separate PhD in Biomedical Physiology and Kinesiology.
name: PhD in Molecular Biology and Biochemistry
